revision_history.state_at_revision: no 7268 NMEE response existed or had been inspected
revision_history.reason: remove an evaluation ambiguity: an unresolved rank was incorrectly listed under both failure and inconclusive
revision_history.change: resolved opposite ranks are failures; ranks indistinguishable within declared numerical uncertainty are inconclusive only

target.role: new S/Se registry, not previously calculated for NMEE

protocol_to_test.structure: one declared fixed bilayer geometry used consistently for Fz=-0.10,0,+0.10 V/nm; relaxation status must be reported rather than assumed
protocol_to_test.control: independently self-consistent fixed-ion external gate states
protocol_to_test.layer_labels: must be fixed by the atomic mapping before responses are inspected

prediction.confidence: low heuristic; deliberately falsifiable, not a universal law or a robust rank claim
prediction.positive_gate_strengthens_or_weakens_eac: not predicted; existing KM and InSe mirror data show that this is independent of the zero-gate signs and rank relation

decision_rule.primary_pass: both rank inequalities are greater than 0.5 by more than the declared numerical uncertainty
decision_rule.primary_fail: either rank inequality is less than 0.5 by more than the declared numerical uncertainty
decision_rule.primary_inconclusive: either rank margin is no larger than the declared mesh/probe sensitivity, or the response protocol/layer mapping differs from the frozen definition
decision_rule.direction_coprediction_pass: C_lower(0)<0 and C_upper(0)>0 with no layer sign reversal between the two gate endpoints
decision_rule.direction_coprediction_fail: a zero-gate sign is resolved opposite to the prediction or a layer reverses sign between the two gate endpoints

basis_available_before_test.fact: same S/Se interface family in registry 7266 has C_lower=-99.10 and C_upper=+110.02 in the archived direct finite-field result, so the upper layer is statically larger; this older direct finite-field response is not the same protocol as the frozen 7268 screened-gate test and supplies only a heuristic sign/rank cue
physical 7269 has the lower layer statically larger but the upper layer carrying 94.8-96.2% of the absolute screened gate slope
changing the relative sign of one interlayer path changes gate-control direction and layer-slope balance while retaining layer response directions

scope_guard: This predicts one registry only and must not be promoted to all MoSSe, all Janus bilayers, or all interfaces.
The upper/lower rank is not symmetry-enforced.
The static rank differences in existing compensated full interfaces can be comparable to numerical sensitivity; repeated archive signs are not a convergence proof.
The 7266 historical direct finite-field result and the 7268 frozen screened-gate protocol are not quantitatively interchangeable.
No prediction is made for the absolute response, experimental detectability, or a universal mixing threshold.
Do not change the endpoint, layer labeling, field definition, or pass rule after seeing 7268.
